summary: Iteration 13 verified: Download My Lines now returns a SINGLE concatenated MP3 (no more ZIP). Updated test_download_lines.py (was written for ZIP in iter 12) to assert audio/mpeg content-type, .mp3 filename in Content-Disposition, ID3/MP3-sync magic bytes, and precise silence-gap arithmetic using pydub. Backend: 7/7 new tests pass. Full backend regression: 108/108 pass (previous iter-12 flaky adam-cache test now green). Frontend: seeded localStorage with the known scene id, picked ELIZA, clicked Download My Lines — Playwright expect_download captured suggested_filename 'Little-House-on-the-Prarie-Eliza_ELIZA.mp3' (ends .mp3, no .zip), 1.35MB payload with ID3 header (0x494433). Cache confirmed working (voice-cache test: second call to same voice returned much faster than first). gap_ms clamped to 10000, gap=0 vs gap=2000 delta matches (N-1)*2000ms within ~400ms tolerance. Bad voice -> 400, unknown character -> 404, missing scene -> 404.

critical_code_review_comments: download_my_lines endpoint correctly uses pydub AudioSegment for concat + silent gap; gap clamped to [0,10000]ms server-side — good defense.
Reuses turn_audio_cache keyed by (scene_id, turn_idx, voice_key) so warm scenes download in <1s. Verified via test_download_lines_voice_cache.
Response headers correct: Content-Type=audio/mpeg, Content-Disposition attachment; filename="scene-slug_CHAR.mp3".
Frontend api.js downloadMyLines reads Content-Disposition and falls back to `${character}.mp3` — matches new format.
server.py is now 1076 lines — approaching the 700-line refactor threshold. Consider splitting TTS/download routes into a router module in a future pass.
Minor: `character` is a required FastAPI query param — missing it returns 422 rather than 400. Cosmetic; not a bug.
